reason: Subagent lifecycle fixes (LIVE-3, SUB-5, SUB-6, SUB-8, SUB-9, SUB-10, SUB-12, GOAL-5), rebased onto #565/#568. The new tests/v3/test_chat_subagent_lifecycle.py pins each rule: failed/stopped parents stop their children with a reason (completed, retryable-answer and restart-interrupted parents keep them; harness failures too), Stop during a next-round start leaves nothing running, approval-blocked children are released when the supervisor ends, rewind retracts the edited exchange's subagents (service and API route), children inherit exactly the parent's SSH hosts at start and on later rounds, goal continuation reuses turn_settings and treats a lost race as expected, goal token budgets bound children as they spend with idempotent true-up charges, and goal active time excludes idle gaps and reports the open stretch once. The other files cover the changed paths: subagent start/stop/rounds/delivery packing/restart (test_chat_subagents, harness provider subagents, subagent choice), goal lifecycle/budgets/read and schedules turn_settings/SSH filtering (test_chat_goals, test_chat_schedules, test_ssh_environments), provider turn claim/release/stop/rewind/budget fitting in the chat service, tool loop and final-answer recovery (test_chat, test_chat_api, test_chat_tool_loop, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery, test_routing_prose_answer, test_reasoning_recovery, test_turn_outcome_history) and agent messaging delivery (test_chat_agent_messages).
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. After #568 test_chat.py, test_chat_subagents.py and test_chat_api.py are selected whole. Node ids replace whole files only for test_harness_provider_subagents.py (excluding test_operator_limit_reaches_the_harness_and_is_enforced) and test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery.py (excluding test_final_synthesis_recovers_from_a_nameless_tool_call_fragment): both nodes fail identically on pristine origin/main c273ea2. test_model_output_budget.py (15 nodes red on main) covers default output sizing, which this change does not touch. No frontend, Playwright or native code changed; the UI reads the same goal fields (elapsed_seconds/active_since) and no controls or layouts changed. Real-Core evidence is recorded in the PR.
